z-m-06-05.title: Uma unamathisela izingcezu ezimbili zonxantathu ndawonye, ingaba i-hexagon?
z-m-06-05.topic: Onxantathu nama-quadrilateral: inani lezinhlangothi zomumo owenziwe ngokunamathisela izingcezu
z-m-06-05.goal: Wazi ukuthi inani lezinhlangothi zomumo owenziwe ngokunamathisela izingcezu ezimbili zonxantathu lingahluka kuye ngokuthi zinamathiselwe kanjani, bese uthola futhi ulungise ingxenye ephosile emcabangweni kaSora.
z-m-06-05.material: Kunezingcezu zephepha ezingu-2 ezimumo onxantathu olungile. Ezi-2 zinosayizi nomumo ofanayo ncamashi. Izinhlangothi ezimbili eziseduze ne-engeli elungile zingu-3cm no-4cm, futhi uhlangothi olude kakhulu lungu-5cm. I-engeli elungile iyikhoneni elisikwele, futhi uma uhlanganisa ama-engeli amabili alungile, aba umugqa owodwa oqondile ongenakho ukugoba. Namathisela ezimbili ndawonye ncamashi ngokuhlangothi olulodwa, ngaphandle kokugqagqana nangaphandle kwesikhala, ukwenza umumo owodwa. Kuhle nakakhulu ukusika iphepha futhi uzame wena. Funda umcabango kaSora umugqa ngomugqa.
z-m-06-05.thinking.1: Hlola igama elithi 'noma ngabe unamathisela kanjani'
z-m-06-05.prereq.0: Izinhlangothi nama-engeli alungile onxantathu, ama-quadrilateral nama-hexagon (izinga leBanga 2)
z-m-06-05.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa owodwa emcabangweni kaSora ongalungile.
z-m-06-05.s.s1.hint.0: Hlukanisa ukuthi umugqa ngamunye ukhuluma ngaphambi kokunamathisela ndawonye noma ngemuva kokunamathisela ndawonye.
z-m-06-05.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga umumo owenziwe ngokunamathisela izingcezu ezimbili zephepha ngokuhlangothi olulodwa, bese ubala izinhlangothi ozibonayo ngaphandle eyodwa ngesikhathi.
z-m-06-05.s.s1.line.2: Uma unamathisela ezimbili ndawonye, izinhlangothi ezimbili ezinamathisiwe azikwazi ukubonwa ngaphandle.
z-m-06-05.s.s1.line.3: Ngakho umumo owenziwe ngokunamathisela unezinhlangothi ezingu-6.
z-m-06-05.s.s1.line.4: Unezinhlangothi ezingu-6, ngakho noma ngabe unamathisela kanjani, uba yi-hexagon.
z-m-06-05.s.s1.explain: Imigqa 4 no-5 ayilungile. Umugqa 3 uthe izinhlangothi ezimbili ezinamathisiwe azikwazi ukubonwa ngaphandle, ngakho izinhlangothi ezibonwa ngaphandle zingu-6 kususwe lezo ezimbili. Kodwa umugqa 4 awukubonisanga lokho. U-6 emgqeni 2 ulungile njengenani lezinhlangothi ngaphambi kokunamathisela. Uma ukhethe umugqa wangaphambili, hlukanisa ukuthi leyo migqa ikhuluma ngaphambi kokunamathisela noma ngemuva kokunamathisela.
z-m-06-05.s.s2.prompt: Kulokhu, namathisela izinhlangothi ezingu-4cm ndawonye, kodwa phendula ucezu olulodwa ukuze amakhoneni amabili e-engeli elungile ahlangane endaweni eyodwa. Uma ubala izinhlangothi ezibonwa ngaphandle ezihlanganiswe emugqeni owodwa njengohlangothi olulodwa, umumo owenziwe ngokunamathisela ungumumo muni?
z-m-06-05.s.s2.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi izinhlangothi ezimbili ezingu-3cm zenza umumo muni lapho amakhoneni amabili e-engeli elungile ehlangana.
z-m-06-05.s.s2.hint.1: Hamba umjikelezo owodwa ezinhlangothini ozibonayo ngaphandle uzikhombe, ubale lezo ezihlanganiswe emugqeni owodwa kanye kuphela.
z-m-06-05.s.s2.r.a: Ucabange ngezinhlangothi ezimbili ezinamathisiwe zinyamalala, kodwa waphuthelwa ukuthi izinhlangothi ezimbili ezihlanganiswe emugqeni owodwa zibukeka njengohlangothi olulodwa.
z-m-06-05.s.s2.r.b: Ucabange ndawonye ngezinhlangothi ezinamathisiwe ezinyamalala nokubala izinhlangothi ezihlanganiswe emugqeni owodwa njengohlangothi olulodwa.
z-m-06-05.s.s2.r.c: Kubonakala sengathi ubale okukodwa okwengeziwe ngenkathi ubala izinhlangothi ezisele. Hamba umjikelezo owodwa ngaphandle bese uzikhomba eyodwa ngesikhathi.
z-m-06-05.s.s2.r.d: Usebenzise inani lezinhlangothi lokuqala ngaphambi kokunamathisela njengoba linjalo. Bheka futhi ukuthi kwenzekani ezinhlangothini ezinamathisiwe.
z-m-06-05.s.s2.explain: Izinhlangothi ezimbili ezinamathisiwe ezingu-4cm zingena ngaphakathi futhi azikwazi ukubonwa. Izinhlangothi ezisele izinhlangothi ezimbili ezingu-3cm nezinhlangothi ezimbili ezingu-5cm. Kodwa njengoba ama-engeli amabili alungile ehlangene, izinhlangothi ezimbili ezingu-3cm ziba umugqa owodwa oqondile, uhlangothi olulodwa olungu-6cm. Ngakho unxantathu onezinhlangothi ezingu-3.
z-m-06-05.s.s3.prompt: Tshela uSora ukuthi kungani 'noma ngabe unamathisela kanjani, uba yi-hexagon' akulungile. Sebenzisa indlela yokunamathisela osanda kuyibheka njengesibonelo.
z-m-06-05.s.s3.hint.0: Ungasebenzisa indlela efanayo yokubala izinhlangothi zomumo oyisebenzisile esinyathelweni sokugcina.
z-m-06-05.s.s3.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi yisiphi isibonelo esisodwa esingenza igama elithi 'noma ngabe unamathisela kanjani' liphose.
z-m-06-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ubale izinhlangothi ezibonwa ngaphandle eyodwa ngesikhathi esibonelweni sakho?
z-m-06-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ubhale wazi ukuthi isibonelo esisodwa siphula igama elithi 'noma ngabe unamathisela kanjani'?
z-m-06-05.s.s3.model.0: Akuhlali kuyi-hexagon. Izinhlangothi ezinamathisiwe azikwazi ukubonwa ngaphandle, futhi uma unamathisela izinhlangothi ezingu-4cm ndawonye, kungaba unxantathu.
z-m-06-05.s.s3.model.1: Kuncike ngokuthi unamathisela kanjani. Uma unamathisela izinhlangothi ezingu-5cm ndawonye, kuba i-quadrilateral enezinhlangothi ezingu-4.
z-m-06-05.s.s3.model.2: Uma unamathisela izinhlangothi ezingu-5 cm ndawonye, kuba i-quadrilateral, ngakho akuyona i-hexagon.
z-m-06-05.s.s3.model.3: Uma unamathisela izinhlangothi ezingu-4 cm ndawonye ukuze amakhoneni amabili e-engeli elungile ahlangane, kuba unxantathu onezinhlangothi ezingu-3. Ngakho noma ngabe unamathisela kanjani, akuyona i-hexagon.

z-m-06-02.title: Yini enye esiyidingayo ukwazi ubude bezintambo ezibofelelwe ndawonye?
z-m-06-02.topic: Ubude: ubude obuphelele bezintambo ezibofelelwe ndawonye (cm)
z-m-06-02.goal: Yazi ukuthi uma ubophela imikhawulo yezintambo ngokuyigqagqanisa, ubude abusona isamba nje, usho ukuthi yiluphi ulwazi oludingekayo ukusho ubude obuqondile, futhi wenze izibonelo zobude obungenzeka.
z-m-06-02.material: UHajun unentambo 가, enobude obungu-40cm, nentambo 나, enobude obungu-35cm. Wagqagqanisa imikhawulo yezintambo ezimbili kancane futhi wazibophela ukwenza intambo eyodwa ende. Intambo yelulwa iqonde ukulinganisa ubude bayo. UHajun wathi, "Kungamalengile ezintambo ezimbili ahlanganisiwe, ngakho intambo ebophelwe ngu-75cm." Asikazi okwamanje ukuthi ingxenye egqagqene ingu-cm bangaki.
z-m-06-02.thinking.0: Hlulela ukuthi ulwazi olunikeziwe lwanele yini
z-m-06-02.prereq.0: Ukufunda ubude nge-cm nokubala kwamadijithi amabili (izinga leBanga 2)
z-m-06-02.s.s1.hint.0: Beka intambo 가 nentambo 나 ngokwehlukana futhi ubheke ukuthi iyiphi ingxenye ephakathi kwazo zombili izintambo uma zibofelelwe ndawonye.
z-m-06-02.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi ingxenye egqagqene kumele ingene izikhathi ezingaki ebudeni obuphelele.
z-m-06-02.s.s1.o.a: Kunjalo. Kunezintambo ezimbili, ngakho wengeza nje ubude.
z-m-06-02.s.s1.r.a: Wengeze ubude njengoba bunjalo ngaphandle kokusebenzisa umbandela wokuthi izintambo zigqagqene futhi zibofelelwe.
z-m-06-02.s.s1.o.b: Ide kuno-75cm. Ukubophela kwenza intambo ibe de.
z-m-06-02.s.s1.r.b: Ucabange ukuthi ukubophela kwenza ibe de. Khumbula ukuthi kwenzekani uma imikhawulo yezintambo igqagqana lapho ubophela.
z-m-06-02.s.s1.r.c: Ubone ukuthi ingxenye egqagqene iku-zombili izintambo kanye ngasinye kodwa ingena ebudeni obuphelele kanye kuphela.
z-m-06-02.s.s1.o.d: Asikwazi ukusho. Lokhu ngoba asazi ukuthi izintambo zijiye kangakanani.
z-m-06-02.s.s1.r.d: Ucabange ukuthi kudingeka ulwazi olungenakho ukuhlobana nobude. Sebenza ukuthi yiluphi ulwazi oludingekayo ngempela.
z-m-06-02.s.s1.explain: Siphindelele futhi sabopha imikhawulo, ngakho ingxenye egqagqene iku-zombili izintambo. Ngakho ifushane kuno-75cm ehlanganisiwe ngobude obugqagqene. Ukwazi ukuthi ifushane kangakanani, sidinga ukwazi ubude obugqagqene.
z-m-06-02.s.s2.prompt: Yini ongadinga ukuyazi ukunquma ubude obuqondile bentambo ebophelwe? Khetha konke okukuvumela ukunquma ubude obuqondile uma usukwazi.
z-m-06-02.s.s2.hint.0: Cabanga ngakukhetha ngakunye ukuthi ungakwazi yini ukunquma ubude bentambo ebophelwe uma usukwazi.
z-m-06-02.s.s2.hint.1: Funa ukuthi ikhona yini indlela yokusebenza ubude nendlela yokwazi ubude ngqo.
z-m-06-02.s.s2.r.c: Uma wazi ubude obugqagqene, ungakhipha leso sinye ebudeni bezintambo ezimbili.
z-m-06-02.s.s2.o.d: Ubude bentambo ebophelwe, elulelwe iqonde futhi yalinganiswa
z-m-06-02.s.s2.r.d: Uma ulinganisa ngqo, ungazi ubude obuphelele ngokushesha ngaphandle kokubala.
z-m-06-02.s.s2.explain: Uma wazi ubude obugqagqene, noma ulula intambo ebophelwe iqonde futhi uyilinganise ngqo, ungazi ubude obuqondile. Ukwazi okukodwa kwalaba ababili kwanele.
z-m-06-02.s.s2.acc.0: Ukukhetha ubude obugqagqene kuphela nakho kungakwazi ukunquma ubude obuqondile. Kungcono nakakhulu uma ucabanga nangendlela yokuyilula futhi uyilinganise ngqo.
z-m-06-02.s.s2.acc.1: Ukukhetha indlela yokulinganisa ngqo kuphela nakho kungakutshela ubude obuqondile. Kungcono nakakhulu uma ucabanga nokuthi ungabala uma wazi ubude obugqagqene.
z-m-06-02.s.s3.prompt: Sho ukuthi ubude obugqagqene bungu-2cm okungenani futhi bungu-7cm okungenani (inombolo yemvelo). Yenza amacala ama-2 ahlukene wokuthi ubude obuphelele bentambo ebophelwe bungaba yini. Bhala ubude obugqagqene njengo-o nobude obuphelele bentambo ebophelwe njengo-t (iyunithi cm).
z-m-06-02.s.s3.hint.0: Khetha ubude obugqagqene futhi usebenze ukuthi leyo ngxenye ingena izikhathi ezingaki ebudeni obuhlanganisiwe bezintambo ezimbili.
z-m-06-02.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala eceleni komunye etafuleni ukuthi ubude obuphelele buyashintsha kanjani uma ubude obugqagqene owukhethayo buyashintsha.

z-m-06-02.s.s3.explain: Uma ubude obugqagqene bungu-2cm bungu-73cm, uma bungu-3cm bungu-72cm, futhi uma bungu-7cm bungu-68cm. Uma ubude obugqagqene buyashintsha, ubude obuphelele nabo buyashintsha, ngakho kunobude obuningi obungenzeka kusukela ku-68cm kuya ku-73cm.
z-m-06-02.s.s4.prompt: Kungaba kuhle kanjani ukulungisa isitatimende sikaHajun esithi '75cm'? Bhala nesizathu sokuthi kungani ulungisa ngaleyo ndlela.
z-m-06-02.s.s4.hint.0: Qala uhlele ukuthi yini elungile nokuthi yini engalungile kulokho uHajun akushoyo.
z-m-06-02.s.s4.hint.1: Khumbula indlela owayikhethile esinyathelweni esingenhla futhi ubhale ukuthi yini okufanele yenziwe ukusho ubude obuqondile.
z-m-06-02.s.s4.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ubhale ucabanga ngokuthi 'isitatimende sikaHajun silungile nini futhi singalungile nini'?
z-m-06-02.s.s4.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ufake nalokho odinga ukukwazi ukwazi ubude obuqondile?
z-m-06-02.s.s4.model.0: Kungase kungabi ngu-75cm. Siphindelele izintambo ezimbili futhi sazibophela, ngakho ifinyela ngobude obugqagqene. Uma wazi ukuthi ingxenye egqagqene ingu-cm bangaki, yikhiphe ku-75.
z-m-06-02.s.s4.model.1: Lula intambo ebophelwe iqonde futhi uyilinganise nge-ruler. Kunengxenye egqagqene, ngakho izophuma ifushane kuno-75cm.

z-m-06-01.title: Uma isikhombi sehora siseduze no-5, ingabe ngu-5 o'clock?
z-m-06-01.topic: Iwashi: ukufunda isikhathi ngesikhombi sehora nesikhombi semizuzu
z-m-06-01.goal: Yazi ukuthi isikhombi sehora sodwa senza kube nzima ukunquma ukuthi lisehora lini nokuthi kumele sifundwe kanye nesikhombi semizuzu, futhi wenze wena izibonelo zezikhathi lapho isikhombi sehora siseduze no-5 kodwa kungekabi ngu-5 o'clock.
z-m-06-01.material: Iwashi le-analog linesikhombi sehora (isikhombi esitshela ihora) nesikhombi semizuzu (isikhombi esitshela imizuzu). Uma isikhombi semizuzu sikhomba ku-12 kuyihora ngqo, futhi isikhala ngasinye senombolo siyimizuzu emi-5. Izinombolo zewashi zingu-1 kuya ku-12. UJiho akakwazi ukubona isithombe sewashi ngqo futhi udlala umdlalo wokuqagela isikhathi ngalokho umngani amtshela khona ngamazwi. Noma ngu-a.m. noma ngu-p.m. akubalulekile.
z-m-06-01.thinking.0: Hlehlisa ukuhlulela noma wengeze imibandela uma ulwazi lungenele
z-m-06-01.thinking.1: Buyekeza isahlulelo sakho njalo uma ulwazi olusha lufika
z-m-06-01.thinking.2: Yenza wena izibonelo zamacala axubanisa kalula
z-m-06-01.prereq.0: Ukufunda izikhathi zehora nezemizuzu emi-5 ewashini le-analog (izinga leBanga 2)
z-m-06-01.s.s1.prompt: Funda lokho umngani wakho akushoyo ucezu olulodwa ngesikhathi, futhi isikhathi ngasinye khetha isikhathi ongasho manje.
z-m-06-01.s.s1.hint.0: Ngaphambi kokuba kufike ulwazi olusha, qala usho emusheni owodwa ukuthi isahlulelo sakho siqinisekile kangakanani.
z-m-06-01.s.s1.hint.1: Uma kufika ulwazi olusha, funda ngokwehlukana lokho isikhombi sehora nesikhombi semizuzu ngasinye esikutshela kona.
z-m-06-01.s.s1.st.0.info: Umngani wathi, "Isikhombi sehora siseduze kakhulu no-5. Angikutsheli ngesikhombi semizuzu okwamanje."
z-m-06-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Isikhombi sehora esiseduze no-5 singavela ngaphambi nje kuka-5, njengo-4:50, noma ngemva nje kuka-5 o'clock. Ngakho ukubuza okwengeziwe ngesikhombi semizuzu nokuqagela nje 'cishe ngu-5 o'clock' kokubili kuyavunyelwa.

z-m-06-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ucabange ukuthi isikhombi sehora singaba ngaphambi nje kuka-5 noma ngemva nje kuka-5.

z-m-06-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Lena umcabango wokuqagela ngemikhondo onayo manje, ukungaqiniseki, nokuzama ukuthola okwengeziwe.

z-m-06-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ufunde inombolo u-2 yesikhombi semizuzu ngqo njengemizuzu emi-2.
z-m-06-01.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ufunde u-2 wesikhombi semizuzu njengemizuzu engu-20. Hlola futhi ukuthi isikhala ngasinye senombolo siyimizuzu emingaki.
z-m-06-01.s.s1.reflect: Ekuqaleni, kusukela esikhombini sehora sodwa, ubungaqagela 'cishe ngu-5 o'clock' noma ubuze okwengeziwe. Lapho kufika ulwazi olusha, isikhombi semizuzu, kwabonakala ukuthi ngisho nehora lingashintsha. Awukwazi ukusho ukuthi inombolo isikhombi sehora esiseduze nayo iyafana nehora lamanje.
z-m-06-01.s.s2.prompt: Yenza izikhathi ezi-2 ezihlukene lapho isikhombi sehora siseduze no-5 kunalapho siseduze no-4 kodwa kungakabi ngu-5 o'clock. Noma kunjalo, kunokulahla u-3m 46cm ngokuphelele, kuhle ukurekhoda ukuthi 'kungenzeka kuhluke ngoba kwakungekho ukuphawula.' Ukukusho njengebanga elisakazekile ngamanani amathathu nakho kulungile.
z-m-06-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Inani eliphezulu, u-3m 46cm, yilona langempela, futhi amanye alinganiswe amafuphi kakhulu.
z-m-06-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ucabange ukuthi inani elikhulu njalo linembile. Uma induku ihlangana, ingaphuma ide empeleni.
z-m-06-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: U-3m 40cm no-3m 41cm owalinganiswa ngokuphawula basondelene, ngakho kuthathwe njengo-3m 40cm cishe, bese uthola okwengeziwe ngokuthi kungani u-3m 46cm wawuhlukile.
z-m-06-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Usebenzise njengesisekelo sakho ukuthi amanani alinganiswe ngendlela efanayo asondelene, futhi wabheka nesizathu senye inani.
z-m-06-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Amanani ahluka isikhathi ngasinye lapho silinganisa, ngakho ubude besakhiwo abukwazi ukwaziwa.
z-m-06-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Uthe ubude abukwazi ukwaziwa nhlobo ngoba amanani ahluka kancane. Bheka ukuthi amanani asondelene ahlangana endaweni eyodwa yini.
z-m-06-04.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Thembela kuwo wonke amanani amathathu bese usho ukuthi isakhiwo siphakathi kuka-3m 40cm no-3m 46cm.
z-m-06-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Awulahlanga lutho nanoma yiliphi inani futhi usho ibanga amanani asakazeke kulo.
z-m-06-04.s.s1.reflect: Inani elilinganiswe kanye lingasetshenziswa kuphela njengo-'cishe,' futhi lapho kufika inani lesibili, kwabonisa ukuthi kunomehluko ongu-6cm. Lapho kufika ulwazi olusha, indlela yokulinganisa, kwakukhona isisekelo sokusho ukuthi yimuphi inani elithenjwa kakhulu. Kunokwethemba inani elilodwa njengelinembile, kuhle ukubheka ndawonye lapho amanani ahlangana khona nendlela.
z-m-06-04.s.s2.prompt: Ufuna ukubhala ubude besakhiwo ebhodini lezaziso. Bhala ukuthi kungaba kuhle kanjani ukukubhala, bese unikeza isizathu esisodwa sokukubhala ngaleyo ndlela.
z-m-06-04.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala amanani amathathu alinganisiwe eceleni komunye bese uhlanganisa amanani afana kakhulu.
z-m-06-04.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi amagama owabhale avumela umfundi ukwazi ukuthi athembe kangakanani leli nani.
z-m-06-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ubhale ubude ukuze umfundi angaqondi ngokuthi 'ncamashi kangaka'?
z-m-06-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Isizathu sakho savela endleleni yokulinganisa noma ekuhlukeni kwamanani?
z-m-06-04.s.s2.model.0: Ubude besakhiwo bungu-3m 40cm cishe. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi ukulinganisa okubili okwenziwa ngokuphawula kwakucishe kufane, u-3m 40cm no-3m 41cm.
z-m-06-04.s.s2.model.1: Ubude besakhiwo buphakathi kuka-3m 40cm no-3m 46cm. Silinganise kathathu futhi amanani ahluke kancane isikhathi ngasinye.

z-m-06-06.title: Kusuka ku-cm ongaki ipenseli 'inde'?
z-m-06-06.goal: Setha izinga lokuhlukanisa elingahluka umuntu nomuntu, njengo-'ipenseli ende,' ngokucacile ngenombolo efana nobude (cm), futhi wazi ukuthi amazinga amaningana angenzeka kudatha efanayo.
z-m-06-06.material: Silinganise ubude bamapenseli angu-8 futhi bekungu-9cm, 11cm, 12cm, 14cm, 15cm, 17cm, 18cm, no-20cm. Wonke ubude balinganiswe ngezinombolo zemvelo (cm) futhi bahlukile komunye nomunye. UJinseo ufuna ukuhlukanisa la mapenseli abe amaqembu amabili, 'amapenseli amade' 'namapenseli amafushane.' Ekuqaleni uJinseo wanquma, 'Amapenseli amade ayimapenseli abukeka ade, futhi amapenseli amafushane ayimapenseli abukeka mafushane.'
z-m-06-06.thinking.0: Hlulela ukuthi izinga lokuhlukanisa licacile yini
z-m-06-06.thinking.2: Wazi ukuthi amazinga ahlukile angenza umphumela ofanayo
z-m-06-06.prereq.0: Ukufunda ubude obulinganiswe nge-cm nokuqhathanisa osayizi bezinombolo (izinga leBanga 2)
z-m-06-06.s.s1.hint.0: Beka amapenseli angu-8 ngokulandelana kobude bese ukhomba kuze kube kuphi ayizibonakaliso zamade.
z-m-06-06.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi wena nomngane ngamunye ungabeka ipenseli ephakathi ohlangothini olufanayo yini uma nihlukanisa ngokuhlukile.
z-m-06-06.s.s1.o.a: Amanani amapenseli amade namapenseli amafushane awalingani.
z-m-06-06.s.s1.r.a: Uxubile izinga lokuhlukanisa nezinombolo emiphumeleni yokuhlukanisa. Amaqembu amabili akadingi ukuba nezinombolo ezilinganayo.
z-m-06-06.s.s1.r.b: Ukulinganisa ubude kuhle, kodwa noma wazi ubude, inkinga efanayo isala uma ungazinqumi ukuthi 'ede' iqala kuphi.
z-m-06-06.s.s1.o.c: Kunamapenseli angu-8 kuphela, ngakho asikwazi ukuwahlukanisa.
z-m-06-06.s.s1.r.c: Ngisho nangamapenseli ambalwa ungawahlukanisa abe amaqembu amabili. Inkinga akusilo inani, kodwa izinga.
z-m-06-06.s.s1.r.d: Ukhombe ukuthi uma izinga lingacacile, umphumela uguquka kuye ngokuthi ngubani ohlukanisayo.
z-m-06-06.s.s1.explain: 'Ibukeka ide' ingazwakala ihluke emuntwini nomuntu. Ipenseli ephakathi, njengepenseli engu-15cm, ingaya noma yiluphi uhlangothi kuye ngomuntu, ngakho sidinga izinga elinika umphumela ofanayo noma ngubani ohlukanisayo.
z-m-06-06.s.s2.prompt: Setha izinga elithi 'ipenseli ide uma ubude bayo bungu-c cm noma ngaphezulu' ukuze umphumela ufane noma ngubani ohlukanisayo. Yenza amapenseli amade abe angu-3 noma ngaphezulu futhi angu-5 noma ngaphansi, bese wenza namapenseli amafushane abe angu-3 noma ngaphezulu (u-c yinombolo yemvelo). Uma amapenseli ehlukaniswa ngendlela efanayo noma u-c ehluka, balwa njengendlela eyodwa. Yenza amanani angu-2 luka-c anika ukuhlukanisa okuhlukile.
z-m-06-06.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala amapenseli ngokulandelana kobude bese uthola ukuthi udweba kuphi umugqa ukuze uhlangothi olude lube namapenseli angu-3 kuya ku-5.
z-m-06-06.s.s2.hint.1: Hambisa umugqa isikhala esisodwa ngesikhathi bese ubala ukuthi inani lamapenseli amade liguquka kanjani.
z-m-06-06.s.s2.ok.c1: U-c uyinombolo yemvelo engu-1 noma ngaphezulu.
z-m-06-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Yenza u-c abe yinombolo yemvelo engu-1 noma ngaphezulu.
z-m-06-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Kunamapenseli amade angaphansi kwangu-3. Zama izinga elincane.
z-m-06-06.s.s2.ok.c3: Kunamapenseli amade angu-5 noma ngaphansi, ngakho kunamapenseli amafushane angu-3 noma ngaphezulu nawo.
z-m-06-06.s.s2.fail.c3: Kunamapenseli amade angaphezu kwangu-5. Zama izinga elikhulu ukuze kube namapenseli amafushane angu-3 noma ngaphezulu.
z-m-06-06.s.s2.explain: Uma u-c engu-13 noma 14, amapenseli angu-14cm, 15cm, 17cm, 18cm, no-20cm amade (amapenseli angu-5), uma u-c engu-15, kunamapenseli angu-4 angu-15cm noma ngaphezulu, futhi uma u-c engu-16 noma 17, kunamapenseli angu-3 angu-17cm noma ngaphezulu. Wonke u-c kusuka ku-13 kuya ku-17 uyenzeka, kodwa kunezindlela ezintathu amapenseli ahlukaniswa ngazo.
z-m-06-06.s.s3.prompt: Sho indlela eyodwa izinga lakho elingcono ngayo kunezinga lokuqala likaJinseo ('amapenseli abukeka made').
z-m-06-06.s.s3.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi abantu bangahluka kanjani ekuhlukaniseni ipenseli engu-15cm ngezinga lokuqala likaJinseo.
z-m-06-06.s.s3.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi, ngezinga lakho, ipenseli engu-15cm iya ohlangothini olufanayo noma ngubani ohlukanisayo yini.
z-m-06-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngenombolo oyisethile, ungasho ngokushesha ukuthi ipenseli engu-15cm ingohlangothini luphi?
z-m-06-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Uma umngane esebenzisa izinga lakho, kuphuma umphumela ofanayo?
z-m-06-06.s.s3.model.0: Uma uyisetha njengo-14cm noma ngaphezulu, kuphuma umphumela ofanayo noma ngubani ohlukanisayo. Uma unquma ngeso, abantu bangahlukanisa ngokuhlukile.
z-m-06-06.s.s3.model.1: Uma usetha izinga ngenombolo, akukho ukudideka ngokuthi ipenseli engu-15cm ide noma ifushane, ngakho kucacile.

z-m-06-09.title: Singanquma ngoLwesine ngamarekhodi alezi zinsuku ezintathu etafuleni?
z-m-06-09.topic: Ithebula lamarekhodi: ukucabanga inani elilandelayo ngamarekhodi okuqala
z-m-06-09.goal: Yazi ukuthi amanani amabalwa okuqala kuphela etafuleni lamarekhodi awakwazi ukwenza inani elilandelayo libe linye, bese ulungisa igama likaDoyun elithi 'kumele.'
z-m-06-09.material: Silinganisa ukuphakama kwempande entsha njalo ekuseni sibhale etafuleni. NgoMsombuluko 1cm, ngoLwesibili 2cm, ngoLwesithathu 4cm. Akukabi khona irekhodi likaLwesine. UDoyun uthe, "Ukwenyuka kwakungu-1 no-2, ngakho okulandelayo kuzokwenyuka ngo-3, ngakho uLwesine ungu-7cm," noHarin uthe, "Njalo ngosuku kuphindeka kabili kusukela osukwini lwangaphambili, ngakho uLwesine ungu-8cm."
z-m-06-09.thinking.0: Yazi ukuthi imithetho eminingana ingafanela idatha efanayo
z-m-06-09.prereq.0: Ukufunda amatafula nokuqhathanisa osayizi bezinombolo (izinga lebanga 2)
z-m-06-09.s.s1.prompt: Ngamarekhodi alezi zinsuku ezintathu etafuleni kuphela, singanquma ukuthi isitatimende sikabani silungile?
z-m-06-09.s.s1.hint.0: Yenza amanani kusukela ngoMsombuluko kuya ngoLwesithathu ngomthetho kaDoyun bese uwaqhathanisa netafula.
z-m-06-09.s.s1.hint.1: Yenza okufanayo ngomthetho kaHarin, bese ubeka imiphumela emibili eceleni komunye nomunye.
z-m-06-09.s.s1.o.a: UHarin ulungile. Umthetho wokuphindeka kabili uyalula.
z-m-06-09.s.s1.r.a: Uthe kulungile ngoba nje umthetho uyalula. Umthetho olula awulungile njalo.
z-m-06-09.s.s1.o.b: Asikwazi ukunquma. Yomibili imithetho ihambisana namarekhodi.
z-m-06-09.s.s1.r.b: Uzame umthetho ngamunye kubabili emarekhodini kaMsombuluko, uLwesibili, noLwesithathu futhi waphawula ukuthi kokubili kuyahambisana.
z-m-06-09.s.s1.o.c: UDoyun ulungile. Ukhulume ngokubala inani lokwenyuka.
